projection: text-only: a row's reference count is a tokenizer/oracle count of the sample's text without chat-template overhead, so the deterministic test compares the estimator's text projection and checks per-message overhead separately against the recorded row value. The live legs compare the array-form estimate (text + overhead per message) against the vendor count, which carries the vendor's own template overhead.
